info.text:
Amway's average US IBO made $750 in 2025, before expenses.

Amway's own US income disclosures (IBOs at Founders Platinum and below): the average stayed between $723 and $852 from 2021 to 2025.
In 2025, 38% of US IBOs had no sales and got no payment; the top 10% of paid IBOs averaged $15,691.
Example: a renewing IBO at the $750 average pays the $55 renewal fee, leaving $695, about $57.92 a month, before other costs.
A Sept 2024 FTC staff review of 70 MLM income disclosures found most participants made $1,000 or less a year. An FTC proposal for stricter MLM earnings-claim rules (Jan 2025) has stalled.

Sources: Amway U.S. Income Disclosures 2021-2025, FTC staff report (Sept 2024), FTC proposed rules (Jan 2025).
News and education, not financial advice.
